limits: A component pass does not replace full workspace Clippy or repository/external/hosted gates.
The parser intentionally rejects missing/duplicate/ambiguous or incomplete outcome evidence.
CLI/platform/evidence-path refusals occur before any component starts; after an evidence run starts the finally block attempts source-after.
Existing exact toolchain/cache must already be present; no dependencies or environment are installed.
reuse: Fixed BASE/SOURCE, existing Python 3.12 and Rust 1.95 paths, owned Cargo target/cache/build-jobs/incremental settings.
Original initial head/tree/clean status, audit preflight, verify_ci_source before/after and equality.
Original file-based complete stdout/stderr, per-command timeout and own process-group termination/capture pattern.
selected_changes: Replace external lane/historical-source preparation with fixed worker artifact Git+physical identity, workspace formatting, strict package Clippy and one whole-module unit run.
Keep HEAD/tree mandatory; no invented future identity or remote publication assumption.
Clear inherited GIT_/RUST_TEST_ and five old reference selector variables in the child environment, recording names only; default Rust harness threading.
Reject nonempty inherited compiler/profile/target overrides rather than replacing them or changing source. No global environment/config mutation.
Use explicit separate component budgets: fmt180s, Clippy1200s, tests1200s; source checks300s and version checks60s, not a hosted/job/confirmation budget.
Require exact ten executed full names, all ok, one ten-test summary with zero failures/ignored/measured; both new controls included.
Attempt source-after on all staged success/failure outcomes; an unreaped timed-out owned child makes status unknown and source-after acceptance false.
